# Latest Bleckmann DC in Lutterworth celebrates going live

 23 July 2026 

Bleckmann, a specialist in supply chain management for fashion and lifestyle brands, is celebrating the go-live of its latest mega distribution centre (DC) in Lutterworth. In less than four months, the new warehouse has been fully prepared for operations. This clearly demonstrates Bleckmann’s speed and flexibility, which enable the company to scale up. 

The warehouse, located in the Midlands’ ‘Golden Triangle’, is suitable for categories such as beauty, hair care, sports and accessories, as well as fashion clothing.

The opening of the DC, which covers 761,932 square feet (70,786 square metres), marks a significant milestone for Bleckmann in the further expansion of its lifestyle logistics offering. With the successful go-live, a key milestone has been reached, and the company is ready to operate at full capacity.

- Date : July 18 2026, 7:16 pm

CEVA Logistics, a global leader in third-party logistics, has announced the opening of a new large-scale warehouse operation in Derby, UK, marking another significant milestone for the company and further strengthening its position as a strategic logistics partner for leading global eCommerce brands.

Supporting regional eCommerce Growth 

CEVA will operate the new 508,000-square-foot warehouse facility in Derby to manage the storage, handling and distribution of customer inventory, enabling faster, more efficient customer deliveries across the UK. # Chinese 3PL secures bonded warehouse in London

Posted on Wednesday 26 August 2026 Share: 

Cainiao UK Supply Chain, a wholly owned subsidiary of Chinese tech and ecommerce conglomerate Alibaba, has taken a warehouse in Feltham, West London close to Heathrow Airport.

 

By Liza Helps, Property Editor, Logistics Matters

THE COMPANY said this would bring customs clearance, inspection and last-mile delivery into one system, allowing cross-border parcels to be delivered as fast as 24 hours after landing, helping maintain stable service levels even during peak promotional periods and supporting Cainiao’s 3-day delivery service in the UK.

It has taken Abrdn Investments 10,269 ft2 Unit 5 property on Central Way, Feltham. It boasts 7,998 ft2 of warehouse floorspace with 8.5m eaves and two level access doors as well as 2,271 ft2 of first floor offices. Sole letting agent was JLL.
